subject: FIN-8981: purge confirmation and proof exchange (prompts/outputs/logs)
body:
From: Gina Harris <gina.harris@finovatepay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: tenant purge (prompts/outputs/logs) - FIN-8981

Hi Priyom,

We need Redwood to complete a full purge for tenant finovatepay covering:
- all prompt inputs and generated outputs for the tenant (metadata + content)
- inference runtime logs (KV cache snapshots, streaming fragments)
- short-lived artifacts (temp stores, prefix caches)

Scope: all artifacts generated between 2025-10-01 and 2026-11-01. This is part of our regulatory cleanup for an audit and we need a signed confirmation and checksumed proof bundle. Estimated regulatory deadline: 2026-11-15.

Please reply with:
1) proposed purge window and ETA for proofs
2) exact artifacts you will delete and the verification artifacts you will provide (manifests, checksums, log extracts)
3) any retention/backup windows that could delay deletion (snapshots, backup TTL)

Thanks,
Gina Harris
Head of Ops, FinovatePay
ops@finovatepay.com

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:05:34 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: tenant purge (prompts/outputs/logs) - FIN-8981

Marissa / Laura / Ben — forwarding FIN-8981 request from FinovatePay. Quick plan below.

Summary: Customer requests full purge + signed verification artifacts for 2025-10-01 -> 2026-11-01. They need proofs delivered before 2026-11-15.

Proposed execution:
1) Run targeted KV/prefix sweep for tenant namespace finovatepay (ops ticket OPS-4321). This will remove prompt/response pairs and derived caches.
2) Expunge associated model-inference logs (rotate and zeroize log segments). Provide redacted log extracts showing deletion actions.
3) Generate an erasure_manifest_FIN-8981.csv listing EIDs, namespaces, deletion timestamps.
4) Produce checksums (sweep_checksums.sha256) and package proof bundle (proof_bundle_FIN-8981.tar.gz).
5) Transfer proofs via customer-provisioned S3 (encrypted) and provide signed manifest (GPG) + internal audit note.

Risks / dependencies:
- Backups: nightly snapshots for the region may contain copies until next retention sweep (we can schedule snapshot truncation; estimate 48 hours to fully clear backups).
- Model-level caches in Dedicated might have replication; we'll confirm replication sweep windows.

Action items:
- Marissa: please schedule the purge and provide OPS ticket and ETA.
- Ben: capture proof artifacts, checksums, and sign manifest.
- Laura: draft reply to the customer with timelines and required links.

Priyom
Head of Compliance Integrations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:22:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: tenant purge (prompts/outputs/logs) - FIN-8981

Priyom — confirming ops execution details.

OPS ticket: OPS-4321 (internal)
Purge window: 2026-11-05 22:00 - 2026-11-06 02:00 PST (quiet hours, single-pass sweep)
Actions executed:
- Namespace sweep: removed all keys under /tenants/finovatepay/ (prompt-store, output-store, kv-cache prefixes).
- Log rotation: rotated inference logs for nodes handling finovatepay, then zeroized the rotated segments.
- Replica sweep: initiated replication sweep across Dedicated pools (confirmed for pool-dc-us-west-2).
- Backup truncation: requested snapshot truncation; next retention job ran 2026-11-06 01:10 and removed snapshot deltas referencing the tenant.

Artifacts generated and attached to this thread:
- erasure_manifest_FIN-8981.csv (CSV; columns: artifact_id, type, namespace, deleted_at, operator)
- sweep_checksums.sha256 (SHA256 checksums for manifest + bundle)
- proof_bundle_FIN-8981.tar.gz (tgz; encrypted; contains signed manifest, redacted log extracts and a short execution transcript)

Notes:
- We redacted any customer PII from the log extracts (we included line-range markers and a short hash for verification).
- Full node-level raw logs are retained for 30 days in an internal secure bucket for forensic review; we provided redacted extracts suitable for customer audit. If customer requires deeper forensic access we can initiate a controlled evidence transfer under NDA.

Forwarding to Priyom to sign and Laura to finalize the external confirmation.

—Marissa
Sr. Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 17:38:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: tenant purge (prompts/outputs/logs) - FIN-8981

Hi Gina,

Thanks for the request. Confirming Redwood executed the purge for tenant finovatepay covering the window 2025-10-01 -> 2026-11-01. Summary of deliverables below.

What we deleted:
- Prompt inputs and generated outputs tied to the finovatepay tenant namespace.
- Runtime/inference logs relevant to request window (redacted extracts included).
- KV/prefix caches and temp store artifacts created during inference.

Proofs we delivered:
- erasure_manifest_FIN-8981.csv — CSV manifest listing artifact IDs, types, namespaces, and deletion timestamps.
- sweep_checksums.sha256 — SHA256 checksums for the manifest and the proof bundle.
- proof_bundle_FIN-8981.tar.gz — encrypted archive containing the signed manifest (GPG), redacted log extracts, and a short ops transcript.

Delivery method:
- Proof bundle uploaded to the customer-provided encrypted S3 path: https://s3.redwood.example/finovatepay/FIN-8981/proofs_encrypted (access granted to ops@finovatepay.com).
- HubSpot record updated: HS-55523.

Important notes:
- Backups: we initiated snapshot truncation; any residual references in prior backups were removed by the scheduled retention job (completed 2026-11-06 01:10 PST). Complete irreversibility across all internal forensic stores is nominally achieved within 72 hours due to cross-region replication; we will confirm final tombstone in 48–72 hours and send a short confirmation email when the internal forensic bucket references are cleared.
- If you require notarized evidence (third-party attestation), we can coordinate an expedited package under an engagement SOW.

Attachments: erasure_manifest_FIN-8981.csv (CSV), sweep_checksums.sha256 (text), proof_bundle_FIN-8981.tar.gz (tgz, encrypted)

If this satisfies your audit, reply with a quick acknowledgement and we will mark the ticket closed.

Regards,

Priyom Das
